xBRIEFInfo.description: Under hard turn or cost budgets, agents can over-deepen verification and exhaust the budget after the stated acceptance bar is already within reach. This story makes budget-aware sizing a first-class rule: bank the stated pass first, then deepen only with remaining budget, and fail-loud when deepening is skipped.

narratives.Description: Under hard turn or cost budgets, agents can over-deepen verification and exhaust the budget after the stated acceptance bar is already within reach. This story makes budget-aware sizing a first-class rule: bank the stated pass first, then deepen only with remaining budget, and fail-loud when deepening is skipped.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent under a declared turn budget, I want to bank the stated acceptance pass before self-imposed deepening, so that I do not exhaust the budget after the official bar is already within reach.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Detect hard budgets at session start from env/flags/host descriptors (packages/core/src/session and related host capability #1461). Add bank-the-pass checkpoint guidance to content/skills/deft-directive-build and deft-directive-pre-pr (and a small packages/core helper or session note if needed for detectable budget). Self-verification depth scales with remaining budget; summary must state when deepening is skipped (#1006 fail-loud). Unit tests for budget detection and guidance surface. Run vitest on touched packages and task check. Cite #3266 in CHANGELOG. Composes #2442 dual-stop, #1581, #3214, #3263.
narratives.Overview: feat(build,session): budget-aware effort sizing - bank the pass before deepening
narratives.NonGoals: Public benchmark naming/scores; removing dual-stop; removing framework ritual entirely.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Items map to issue acceptance sketch.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a hard max-turns or max-budget flag or host-declared limit at session start, when session posture is established, a detectable budget signal is available to build/pre-pr guidance.
Given remaining budget and stated acceptance criteria not yet satisfied, when build guidance applies, it prioritizes stated AC over self-imposed deeper verification suites.

narrative.Acceptance: Given deepening is skipped for budget, when the run summary is written, it states that deepening was skipped rather than silent gold-plate or silent skip.
